# Space panorama prompt

Built-in imagegen, 2026-10-12; opaque background. Output retained as `space.png`
without subsequent pixel edits or resizing. The initial prompt below is
retained for provenance; the final native 2172×724 output uses the edit below.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game skydome seamless full-sphere
equirectangular SPACE panorama. A 2:1 panoramic 360 degree texture, ideally
2048x1024, for inside a spherical sky dome, representing longitude horizontally
and elevation +90 at top to -90 at bottom. Deep near-black navy space, mostly
quiet empty space, tiny finely scattered white stars, a restrained soft muted
violet-blue nebula flowing across one area. A single small subtly crescent-lit
distant blue-grey planet in the upper half, no large looming objects, no sun,
no atmosphere clouds, no scenery, no text or watermarks. Semi-realistic painted
classic videogame environment art, calm understated readable background.
CRITICAL wrap: left and right outermost 15% contain the same constant very dark
navy with no stars or nebulas, top and bottom 5% same constant dark navy to avoid
polar pinching. Do not draw a picture frame, borders, panel divisions, glowing
grids or sci-fi interface.

## Selected high-resolution edit

Use case: stylized-concept. Edit target: space panorama. Refine this into a
native high resolution extremely wide 3:1 full sphere skydome panorama,
3072x1024 preferred, at least 2048 pixels wide. Keep understated dark
navy/black space, tiny crisp stars of varied dim brightness, graceful pale
blue and muted violet Milky Way band with fine wispy interstellar dust, one
small crescent planet far left of center. Natural detailed believable space
artwork without noisy bright decorative clouds. Top zenith and bottom nadir
taper to nearly black to avoid pole pinching. Both outermost horizontal
10 percent taper to almost black for seamless longitude wrap. Preserve
subtle luminosity and visual breathing space. Opaque image. No landscape,
text, artificial lens flare or watermark.
